hook_stat.sub: Nifty 50 fall in 2026, on course for its worst annual performance in over a decade

news_summary: India's Nifty 50 has fallen about 13% this year and is on course for its worst annual performance in over a decade, with Spark Capital telling Reuters the slide may not yet be a buying opportunity.
payoff: A technical rebound is plausible in November, but a durable re-rating needs earnings to hold, crude to ease and foreign money to return.
